leading_positions.synthesis: Six of eight members name B029 (targeted protein degradation) as the sole prize part in their round-1 configuration. All six describe it as a new chemical principle (event-driven, catalytic induced proximity) confirmed by many independent groups. They share Crews and Deshaies but differ on the third name and on the scope of the citation. Aili, Aqvist, Brzezinski and Linke name Crews, Deshaies and Handa, with a citation covering PROTACs and the cereblon-based molecular-glue strand. Chabes and Somfai name Crews, Deshaies and Ciulli, with a citation limited to heterobifunctional PROTACs, which leaves out the cereblon and glue strand. Brzezinski and Linke each say they moved or conceded toward B029 from a different first preference.

Sparr alone proposes a two-part prize: B055 (Hyman and Brangwynne, biomolecular condensates) and B006 (Cullis alone, ionizable lipid nanoparticles). She argues from physical-chemical substance, says the opening tally does not support this pairing, and lists B029 as an alternative. No other member prefers either part.

Zou alone prefers B047 (base editing), now narrowed to Liu alone after reconsidering her opening three-name configuration. She lists B029 as her first alternative. B047 is an alternative for Aili, Brzezinski, Chabes and Linke, but none of them prefers it in their configuration.

areas_of_agreement: B029 is the broadest-supported candidate: the eight opening ballots ranked it in seven top-three positions, and six of eight round-1 configurations now feature it.
Every B029 supporter regards the mechanism (E3 ligase recruitment, ternary-complex formation, cereblon as the thalidomide target) as well established and independently confirmed.
All six B029 supporters state that attribution under a three-name cap is hard for B029, and name Ciulli, Handa, Sakamoto, Ito, Gray and Kim as credible claims left out of any trio.
All six B029 supporters state that no degrader drug is yet approved and that clinical vindication is incomplete.
Members who prefer other candidates acknowledge in their own statements that B029 has far wider support than their first choice (Brzezinski for B056, Sparr, Zou).
scientific_disputes: Whether PROTACs (heterobifunctional design) and molecular glues (cereblon mechanism) are one achievement or two separate lineages that a single citation would blur.
Whether B047 base editing is a sufficiently distinct chemical advance or an extension of the CRISPR-Cas9 work recognised in Chemistry 2020 (raised by Zou, Chabes and Linke).
Whether phase separation in vivo (B055) reflects true equilibrium liquid-liquid phase separation, and whether it will be judged chemistry or cell biology (Sparr, Aili).
Whether B043 (Pd C-N coupling) is a new achievement or a refinement of the Pd cross-coupling area recognised in 2010 (Somfai, Aili).
attribution_disputes: Third laureate for B029: Handa (cereblon, glue strand; Aili, Aqvist, Brzezinski, Linke) versus Ciulli (VHL ligands, ternary-complex structure; Chabes, Somfai). Brzezinski's trio names Handa, but his alternatives and statement treat Ciulli as a live contender over Deshaies.
Whether Sakamoto (co-author of the 2001 PROTAC paper), Ito, Gray and Kim should appear anywhere in a B029 configuration.
B047: Liu alone (Zou) versus a trio with Komor and Gaudelli, and the weight of Kondo and Nishida's independent deaminase-Cas9 fusion.
B006: whether crediting Cullis alone fairly represents the lineage of Hope, Madden, MacLachlan, Langer and Anderson (Sparr).
B055: whether Rosen, Pappu or Mittag should displace one of Hyman and Brangwynne under the three-person cap (Sparr).
B058 (Linke's alternative): whether a three-name perovskite prize is fair given Kojima's absence from the credited list and the Grätzel and Seok claims.
maturity_disputes: Whether the lack of an approved degrader drug should delay a B029 award; Aili argues mechanistic confirmation and field adoption matter more than regulatory approval, while Brzezinski, Linke and Somfai treat it as a real caution.
Whether B029 is premature relative to older, more mature candidates such as B043 (Somfai) or B056 (Brzezinski).
Whether the long-term safety and off-target data for base editing are mature enough for a 2026 award (Zou).
Whether a settled field is needed before recognising biomolecular condensates (Aili, Sparr).
conflict_or_recusal_flags: Brzezinski: his research on respiratory-chain electron and proton transfer is close to B056, which he ranked first and may overweight; he is also a Stockholm University colleague of Zou, who is not a candidate.

Sparr: her work on lipid self-assembly and lipid-protein co-assembly is scientifically close to B055 and B006, both in her configuration; she states no tie to any credited name and sees no recusal need.

Linke (chair): his physics background may bias him toward mechanism arguments such as B058; Lund overlaps with Somfai and Sparr and he has co-presented with Aqvist, with no tie to any shortlisted candidate.
Aqvist: his computational work on ligand-binding free energies is adjacent to B027 and to computational drug discovery; no personal tie to credited names is stated.
Aili, Chabes, Somfai and Zou each report no specific conflict; Somfai and Zou note only ordinary institutional connections to other members (Lund and Stockholm respectively).
questions_for_round2: Should the B029 citation cover heterobifunctional PROTACs only (Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli) or PROTACs together with the cereblon glue mechanism (Crews, Deshaies, Handa), and can a single citation do either without misrepresenting the history?
Does the committee prefer Handa or Ciulli as the third B029 name, and what is the justification in discovery terms rather than field prominence?
Is the absence of an approved degrader drug a reason to defer B029, and if so what evidence would the committee treat as sufficient?
Would a two-part prize (for example B029 with B047, B006 or B055) be preferable to a single-part B029, and can any second part be justified independently of B029's support?
Is B047 distinct enough from the 2020 CRISPR-Cas9 prize, and if so should it credit Liu alone or also Komor, Gaudelli, Kondo and Nishida?
Can Sparr's B055 and B006 configuration attract support from members who currently prefer B029, and what would Sparr need to see to move to B029?
summary.chair_observation: In round 1, six of eight members prefer B029 alone, Sparr prefers a B055 plus B006 pair, and Zou prefers B047 with Liu alone. The six B029 supporters split 4 to 2 between Handa and Ciulli as the third name, so the real open question is the scope and wording of the citation, not whether B029 is the leading candidate. This summary counts only positions stated in the eight round-1 files and implies no ruling.
